login.heading: Sign in to start your shift
login.subline: Repair help from your plant's own experts, in your language.
login.forgotPin: Forgot your PIN? Ask your supervisor to reset it.
login.invalidLogin: Wrong employee ID or PIN. Please try again.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Try again in a few minutes, or ask your supervisor to help.
login.networkError: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
login.webHeadline: Every fix your experts make, ready for the next shift.
login.webSub: Review repairs, answer escalations and keep your plant's know-how in one place.
login.technicianNote: Technician? Open Kaarigar on your phone and sign in with your employee ID and PIN.
login.roleNote: Role-based access · your plant's data stays in your workspace
login.wrongEmailPw: Wrong email or password. Please try again.
login.enterBoth: Enter your work email and password.

tech.scanQr: Point the camera at the QR sticker on the machine
tech.noMachines: No machines in your plant yet. Ask your supervisor to set them up.

manager.emptyBody: Nothing waiting yet. Approved repairs will show up here.

record.title: Record a repair
record.promptTitle: Speak in your own language. Say:
record.prompt1: What was wrong with the machine
record.prompt3: How you fixed it, step by step

errors.insecure: Recording needs a secure (https) link. Open the app from the tunnel link.
errors.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Use Chrome.
errors.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow the microphone in the browser settings and try again.
errors.no_mic: No microphone found on this device.
errors.failed: Couldn't start the microphone. Try again.

record.keepTalking: Keep talking. Tap again when you're done.

note.title: Your note
note.notFound: This note doesn't exist or isn't yours.
note.canLeave: You can leave this screen. Your note will be ready in My notes.
note.approvedText: Other technicians can now find this repair when they ask.

check.title: AI check
check.intro: Check what we wrote down. Fix anything that's wrong, then send it to your supervisor.
check.safetyMissing: No safety step was mentioned. Add one if this job needs it.
check.toggleLocked: Send or undo your changes first
check.discardConfirm: Delete this note and its recording? This can't be undone.

fields.safetyPlaceholder: e.g. Lower the ram onto safety blocks first

sent.title: Sent
sent.next: Your supervisor will check it. Once approved, other technicians can find this repair.

errors.no_speech: We couldn't hear a repair note. Record again a little closer to the phone.
errors.too_short: The recording is too short. Describe the repair in a few sentences.
errors.too_long: The recording is too long. Keep it under 3 minutes.
errors.bad_audio: This recording couldn't be read. Please record again.
errors.stt_failed: Speech service is busy. Tap Try again in a minute.
errors.llm_failed: The AI helper is busy. Tap Try again in a minute.
errors.server_restarted: The server restarted while working on your note. Tap Try again.
errors.upload_failed: Couldn't send the recording. Check your connection and try again.
errors.storage_failed: Couldn't save the recording. Try again.
errors.audio_too_big: The recording is too large. Keep it under 3 minutes.
errors.unsupported_audio: This recording format isn't supported. Use Chrome.
errors.audio_empty: The recording is empty. Record again.
errors.not_allowed: Only experts and supervisors can record repairs.
errors.not_editable: This note can't be changed now.
errors.not_deletable: Notes sent to the supervisor can't be deleted.
errors.still_processing: Wait until the note has been processed.
errors.record_again: This note can't be fixed by retrying. Please record again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

review.title: Review queue
review.empty: Nothing waiting yet. Approved repairs will show up here.
review.reasonLabel: Why are you sending it back?
review.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The cause isn't clear. Please record again and say what you found.
review.ownRecord: You recorded this note, so another supervisor needs to review it.

errors.own_record: You can't review your own record.
errors.incomplete: Add at least the problem and the fix before approving.

review.needProblemAndFix: Add the problem and the fix to approve.
review.emptyFieldHint: Not stated by the expert. Add it if you know it.

reasons.cause: Cause is not clear. Please say what you found.
reasons.steps: Please say the repair steps in order.
reasons.safety: Please add the safety step you followed.
reasons.wrongMachine: This doesn't match the machine. Please check and record again.

machine.askHint: Say what's wrong. Kaarigar answers from this plant's repairs and manuals.

ask.title: Ask Kaarigar
ask.prompt: Tell Kaarigar what's wrong, in your own language.
ask.example: For example: "Pressure not building, pump is making a thak-thak sound."

answer.noAnswer: Kaarigar couldn't find this in what it knows. An expert can help.
answer.noAnswerMachine: Kaarigar couldn't find this for {{code}} in the plant's repairs or manuals. An expert can help.

source.title: Where this comes from
source.noText: This page has no readable text.
source.error: This source couldn't be opened. Try again.

escalate.title: Ask an expert
escalate.help: Kaarigar will send your question and its answer to the expert who knows this machine best.
escalate.notePlaceholder: For example: I already changed the filter.

reply.waiting: Waiting for an expert to answer.
reply.fixedMyself: It's fixed now, I don't need help
reply.notReviewedYet: The supervisor will check this answer before Kaarigar uses it for others.
reply.addedToKnowledge: Added to Kaarigar. It can now answer this for others.

closed.fixed_by_technician: You fixed it yourself, so the question was closed.

question.title: My question
question.stillAnswering: Kaarigar is still answering. Come back in a moment.

empty.done: You haven't answered any questions yet.

answerQ.title: Answer a question
answerQ.didNotWork: They said this didn't fix it.
answerQ.voiceHelps: A recorded answer is saved, so Kaarigar can answer this itself next time.
answerQ.sayFix: Say what's wrong, why, and how to fix it step by step

qr.unknown: This QR code isn't a Kaarigar machine sticker from your plant.

errors.no_speech: We couldn't hear a question. Hold the phone closer and ask again.
errors.too_short: That was too short. Tap the gauge and ask your question.
errors.too_long: Keep your question under one minute.
errors.bad_audio: This recording couldn't be read. Please ask again.
errors.stt_failed: The speech service is busy. Try again, or type your question.
errors.llm_failed: The AI helper is busy. Try again in a minute, or ask an expert.
errors.search_failed: Kaarigar couldn't search right now. Try again or ask an expert.
errors.busy: Many people are asking right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.server_restarted: The server restarted while answering. Ask again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again or ask an expert.
errors.rate_limited: You're asking very fast. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.machine_not_found: This machine isn't in your plant.
errors.audio_too_big: The recording is too long. Keep it under one minute.
errors.audio_empty: The recording is empty. Ask again.
errors.unsupported_audio: This phone's recording format isn't supported. Type your question instead.
errors.stream_cut: The connection dropped before the answer finished. Open My questions or try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
errors.tts_failed: Reading aloud isn't available right now.
errors.not_open: This question was already answered or closed.
errors.assigned_to_other: Another expert is answering this question.
errors.reply_in_progress: You already have an answer waiting to be checked.
errors.own_question: You can't answer your own question.

voice.autoSpeak: Speak answers aloud when I ask by voice

vad.waiting: Speak now. It sends when you stop.
vad.heardNothing: I didn't hear anything. Tap the gauge and try again, closer to the phone.

empty.open: No open questions. Kaarigar is handling everything.

escalations.actionError: That didn't work. Refresh and try again.

kaarigar.no_answer: Kaarigar had no answer from the plant's knowledge.
kaarigar.cancelled: The technician left before the answer finished.

feedback.fixed: The technician said this fixed it.
feedback.not_fixed: The technician said this didn't fix it.
feedback.call_supervisor: The technician asked for a supervisor.

escalations.nobodyYet: Nobody is assigned yet. Pick an expert above.
escalations.inReviewQueue: This answer is in the Review queue. Approve it to add it to Kaarigar's knowledge.

errors.load: Couldn't load this page. Check the connection and reload.
errors.bad_employee_id: Employee ID: 2–20 letters, digits or dashes, like SH-0521.
errors.employee_id_taken: This employee ID is already used in this plant.
errors.employee_id_required: Technicians and experts sign in with an employee ID.
errors.email_required: Supervisors sign in on the web with their work email.
errors.login_exists: This employee ID or email already has a login.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Who can use Kaarigar in this plant.
people.summary: {{active}} people can sign in · {{new}} haven't signed in yet

empty.current: No people yet. Add your technicians and experts so they can sign in on their phones.
empty.new: Everyone has signed in at least once.

roleHint.expert: Also records repairs and answers questions

form.supervisorFixed: Supervisors sign in with email, so their role can't change to technician or expert.
form.name: Full name
form.employeeIdHint: The ID printed on their card. They type it with a PIN to sign in.
form.emailHint: They sign in at the web dashboard with this email.
form.languageHint: Kaarigar listens and answers in this language. They can change it in the app.
form.adminHint: Can add people and machines, upload documents and breakdown logs.

reset.title: New PIN for {{name}}?
reset.body: Their old PIN stops working right away. You'll see the new PIN once, to give to them.
reset.bodyEmail: Their old password stops working right away. You'll see a temporary password once, to give to them.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: They can't sign in any more. Their repair notes stay in the knowledge base with their name. Questions waiting for them go back to unassigned.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: They can sign in again with their old PIN or password. If they forgot it, make a new one after this.

slip.title: Login for {{name}}
slip.once: This is the only time you'll see this. Kaarigar doesn't keep it. Give it to them now or print the slip.
slip.howPin: Open Kaarigar on your phone, enter your employee ID and this PIN.
slip.howEmail: Sign in at the Kaarigar dashboard and change this password from the login page.

machines.title: Machines
machines.summary: {{count}} machines on the floor · {{missing}} without a printed sticker
machines.emptyHint: Add each machine with its code. Then print its QR sticker so technicians can scan it.

form.name: Name
form.modelHint: Manuals are uploaded per model, so all machines of a model share them.

archive.title: Archive {{code}}?
archive.body: It disappears from technicians' machine lists and its sticker stops opening it. Its repairs and history stay in the knowledge base. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore {{code}}?
restore.body: It comes back on technicians' machine lists and its sticker works again.

newqr.title: Make a new QR for {{code}}?
newqr.body: The old sticker stops working right away. Use this when a sticker is lost or damaged, then print and stick the new one.

stickers.subtitle: A4, 8 stickers per page. Print on sticker paper or plain paper and laminate.
stickers.none: No machines selected. Go back and tick the machines you want stickers for.
stickers.tip: Print at 100% scale (not "fit to page"). When they're on the machines, mark them as printed.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.subtitle: Everything Kaarigar answers from: expert repairs, manuals and breakdown history.
knowledge.emptyHint: Approve expert repairs in the review queue, or upload a manual in
knowledge.noMatch: Nothing matches. Try other words or another machine.
knowledge.searchNotUpdated: Restored, but Kaarigar couldn't update search right now. It will be used in answers after the next reindex.

archive.title: Archive this repair?
archive.body_one: Kaarigar stops using it in answers right away. It was used in {{count}} answer. You can restore it later.
archive.body_other: Kaarigar stops using it in answers right away. It was used in {{count}} answers. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore this repair?
restore.body_one: Kaarigar starts using it in answers again.
restore.body_other: Kaarigar starts using it in answers again.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Manuals, SOPs and safety sheets Kaarigar reads to answer questions.

form.tooBig: This file is bigger than {{mb}} MB. Split it or compress it first.
form.title: Title
form.noModels: Add a model in Machines first.

job.doneText: Done. Kaarigar can now answer from this document.

documents.duplicate: This file is already uploaded for this model. Replace the old copy?
documents.emptyHint: Upload the service manual for each machine model. Kaarigar cites the page in its answers.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this document?
confirmDelete.body: Kaarigar stops answering from it. Past answers keep their text but the page link stops working.

logs.title: Breakdown logs
logs.subtitle: Import your breakdown register so Kaarigar knows what went wrong before and what fixed it.
logs.uploadHelp: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, the way your plant already keeps it. Kaarigar finds the header row and suggests which column is which.
logs.tooBig: This file is bigger than {{mb}} MB.
logs.duplicate: This exact file was imported before. Import it again anyway?
logs.suggestedAi: Kaarigar suggested the columns below. Check them.
logs.suggestedRules: Columns matched by their names. Check them.
logs.otherColumns: Other columns are kept with each entry but not used for search.
logs.unknownMachineHint: "Unknown machine" means the code isn't in Machines. Add the machine, then import the file again.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Is Kaarigar helping the floor, and where is knowledge missing?
analytics.noQuestions: No questions in this period yet. Numbers appear once technicians start asking.

perDay.title: Questions per day
perDay.aria: Questions per day, answered and not answered. Use left and right arrow keys to read each day.

gaps.title: What Kaarigar couldn't answer
gaps.none: Kaarigar answered everything in this period.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who asks, who adds knowledge, and how often their knowledge answered someone else's question.

scan.title: Scan machine QR
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR sticker on the machine
scan.badCode: Type a machine code like HP-07.
scan.notKaarigar: This isn't a Kaarigar machine sticker.
scan.notInPlant: This sticker isn't for a machine in your plant, or it was replaced. Ask your supervisor for a new sticker.
scan.offline: No connection. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data.
scan.lookupFailed: Couldn't open the machine. Try again.

problem.permission: Kaarigar isn't allowed to use the camera.
problem.permissionHow: Tap the lock icon next to the address (or open Android Settings → Apps → Kaarigar → Permissions) and allow Camera, then come back.
problem.no_camera: No camera found on this device. Type the machine code below.
problem.insecure: The camera only works on the secure (https) address of Kaarigar. Type the machine code below.
problem.camera_failed: The camera didn't start. Close other apps using it, or type the machine code below.
